s: Zarathustra has Gâthas (five holy Gâthas)
q: the five Gâthas of Zarathustra, the Spitâma, the holy

s: Haoma is a healer (reviver, beautiful and kingly, with a golden eye)
q: he Haoma, the reviver, and the healer, the beautiful, the kingly, of the golden eye

s: Angra Mainyu is a wicked one
q: to hew down Angra Mainyu, the wicked

s: Mãthra is body of the mighty, the incarnate word of reason
q: the mighty, the incarnate word of reason, whose body is the Mãthra

s: Sraosha is devoted to Ahura Mazda
q: him of the daring spear, devoted to the Lord

s: Sraosha is a holy ritual lord
q: We worship Sraosha, (Obedience) the blessed, the stately, him who smites with the blow of victory, and who furthers the settlements, the holy, (ruling) as the ritual lord.

s: Sraosha is first to adore Ahura Mazda (in the creation of Mazda)
q: Him do we worship, who in the creation of Mazda the first adored Ahura

s: Sraosha is first to worship Bountiful Immortals
q: who worshipped the Bountiful Immortals (first)

s: Sraosha worships Bountiful Immortals (with the Baresman spread)
q: who first spread forth the Baresman, and the three bundles, and the five bundles, and the seven bundles, and the nine, till it was heaped for us knee-high, and to the middle of the thighs, for the Bountiful Immortals, for their worship, and their homage, and their propitiation, and their praise

s: Demon-gods makes no choice righteous (between these two spirits)
q: And between these two spirits the Demon-gods (and they who give them worship) can make no righteous choice

s: Demon-gods cannot choose Righteousness (righteously between the two spirits)
q: And between these two spirits the Demon-gods (and they who give them worship) can make no righteous choice

s: worshippers of the Demon-gods cannot choose Righteousness (righteously between the two spirits)
q: And between these two spirits the Demon-gods (and they who give them worship) can make no righteous choice

s: Evil Mind is a personified worst mind
q: As they were questioning and debating in their council the (personified) Worst Mind approached them that he might be chosen.

s: Demon of Fury is a demon
q: And thereupon they rushed together unto the Demon of Fury, that they might pollute the lives of mortals.

s: Demon of Fury pollutes life (the lives of mortals)
q: And thereupon they rushed together unto the Demon of Fury, that they might pollute the lives of mortals.

s: Âramaiti is a personified Piety of the saints
q: Upon this Âramaiti (the personified Piety of the saints) approached

s: Âramaiti is associated with Sovereign Power (approaching with)
q: Upon this Âramaiti (the personified Piety of the saints) approached, and with her came the Sovereign Power, the Good Mind, and the Righteous Order.

s: Âramaiti gives body (to the spiritual creations of good and evil)
q: And (to the spiritual creations of good and of evil) Âramaiti gave a body, she the abiding and ever strenuous.

s: Sovereign Power comes with Âramaiti, the Good Mind, and the Righteous Order
q: Upon this Âramaiti (the personified Piety of the saints) approached, and with her came the Sovereign Power, the Good Mind, and the Righteous Order.

s: two first spirits is a pair (independent in action)
q: Thus are the primeval spirits who as a pair (combining their opposite strivings), and (yet each) independent in his action, have been famed (of old).

s: Good Mind is a spiritual faculty
q: Upon this Âramaiti (the personified Piety of the saints) approached, and with her came the Sovereign Power, the Good Mind, and the Righteous Order.

s: Righteousness is a Divine Righteousness
q: but the more bounteous spirit chose the (Divine) Righteousness;

s: Ahura Mazda is addressed as living Lord
q: then, O Mazda! the Kingdom shall have been gained for Thee by (Thy) Good Mind (within Thy folk). For to those, O living Lord! does (that Good Mind) utter his command

s: Ahura Mazda is contented by righteous actions (actions performed in accordance with the faith)
q: And He chose likewise them who content Ahura with actions, which (are performed) really in accordance with the faith.

s: Demon of the Lie is a demon
q: who will deliver the Demon of the Lie into the two hands of the Righteous Order

s: Demon of the Lie is opposed by Righteousness (as a captive to a destroyer)
q: who will deliver the Demon of the Lie into the two hands of the Righteous Order (as a captive to a destroyer).

s: Daêvas ally with Demon of Fury (in the great struggle)
q: And (when the great struggle shall have been fought out which began when the Daêvas first seized the Demon of Wrath as their ally

s: Daêvas is a demon-gods
q: And (when the great struggle shall have been fought out which began when the Daêvas first seized the Demon of Wrath as their ally

s: world has state progressive (until its perfection shall have been reached)
q: and make this world progressive, (till its perfection shall have been reached).

s: world has final state perfection
q: and make this world progressive, (till its perfection shall have been reached).

s: two first spirits have opposed qualities more bountiful spirit (as to thought, word, and deed)
q: (They are) a better thing, they two, and a worse, as to thought, as to word, and as to deed.

s: Heaven is a Best Mental State (for the holy)
q: for the holy (Heaven) the Best Mental State,

s: Hell is a worst life (for the wicked)
q: for the wicked (Hell) the worst life

s: life has opposite absence of life
q: to make life, and life's absence

s: great struggle begins with Daêvas (when they first seized the Demon of Wrath as their ally)
q: And (when the great struggle shall have been fought out which began when the Daêvas first seized the Demon of Wrath as their ally

s: great renovation makes world (progressive until perfection)
q: may we be such as those who bring on this great renovation, and make this world progressive, (till its perfection shall have been reached).

s: salvation is received by men (when the foretold course has begun)
q: And when these (shall have begun their course), salvation shall be (your portion)!

s: righteous gather in happy abode (after perfection has been attained)
q: but swiftest in the happy abode of the Good Mind and of Ahura the righteous saints shall gather

s: wicked receive worst life (in Hell)
q: for the wicked (Hell) the worst life

s: righteous receive Best Mental State (in Heaven)
q: for the holy (Heaven) the Best Mental State

s: two first spirits have opposed qualities Evil Spirit (as to thought, word, and deed)
q: (They are) a better thing, they two, and a worse, as to thought, as to word, and as to deed.

s: more bountiful spirit is a bounteous spirit
q: He who was the evil of them both (chose the evil), thereby working the worst of possible results, but the more bounteous spirit chose the (Divine) Righteousness;

s: Evil Spirit is a evil spirit
q: He who was the evil of them both (chose the evil), thereby working the worst of possible results, but the more bounteous spirit chose the (Divine) Righteousness;

s: more bountiful spirit chose Righteousness (as its realm)
q: but the more bounteous spirit chose the (Divine) Righteousness;

s: Evil Spirit chose evil (as its realm)
q: He who was the evil of them both (chose the evil), thereby working the worst of possible results

s: Evil Spirit works worst of possible results
q: He who was the evil of them both (chose the evil), thereby working the worst of possible results

s: Yasna LVIII (Sp. LVII) is a Yasna
q: Yasna LVIII (Sp. LVII).

s: Ahura Mazda is a creator
q: the creative stars of Ahura Mazda, the Creator

s: owner of herds is a righteous one
q: The owner of herds is the righteous (one)

s: owner of herds is victorious (when he strikes)
q: and he is victorious when he strikes

s: owner of herds is best
q: and thus he is the best

s: owner of herds is a father of Kine (by the help of him who follows the ritual order)
q: for the herd-owner is the father of the Kine by the help of him who follows the ritual order

s: owner of herds is a father of holy man
q: and he is the father of the holy man as well

s: owner of herds is a father of entire creation
q: and of the sanctified creation.

s: owner of herds is a bestower of blessings (in verity)
q: He is in verity the bestower of blessings

s: owner of herds is a watchman for worship (together with the Righteous Order)
q: and let this man, the cattle-owner, approach to guard over us; and may he be our watchman together with the Righteous Order

s: Righteous Order is a order (righteous)
q: and may he be our watchman together with the Righteous Order

s: Bountiful Immortals save holy men (as they have made them)
q: as Ye have made us, so do Ye save us, holy men

s: Bountiful Immortals save saintly women (as they have made them)
q: so do Ye save us, holy men, and saintly women (as we are, and steadfast in the faith).

s: Bountiful Immortals rule rightly
q: Ye who rule aright

s: Bountiful Immortals dispose all (aright)
q: and who dispose (of all) aright

s: Fire grants Weal
q: grant us both Weal and Deathlessness!

s: Fire grants Deathlessness
q: grant us both Weal and Deathlessness!

s: Praises of the Yasna is a collection (entire)
q: We sacrifice to the entire collection of the Praises of the Yasna

s: Praises of the Yasna has careful structure of language (which has reached the most its object)
q: with the careful structure of their language which has reached the most its object

s: worship shields from Daêva (as a defence)
q: let this our worship shelter us from the Daêva

s: Praises of the Yasna is a production of world of old
q: Yea, we worship the Praises of the Yasna which were the production of the world of old.

s: worship shields from evil-minded man (as a defence)
q: and from the evil-minded man.

s: Blessedness accompanies worship (of a verity)
q: and Blessedness is with it of a verity

s: Âramaiti accompanies worship
q: and Piety as well

s: worship protects settlements (for protection and care, guarding, and oversight)
q: to this worship do we confide our settlements and persons for protection and care, for guarding, and for oversight

s: worship protects persons (for protection and care, guarding, and oversight)
q: to this worship do we confide our settlements and persons for protection and care, for guarding, and for oversight

s: worship is a praise (of such as Ahura Mazda)
q: to such worship as is the praise of such as You.

q: Yasna LIX (Sp. LVIII).
